title: Romualdez at QC jail infirmary with 3 other PDLs — Remulla
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez was assigned to the infirmary of the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas with three fellow persons deprived of liberty (PDLs), according to…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker Martin Romualdez was assigned to the infirmary of the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas with three fellow persons deprived of liberty (PDLs), according to Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla. The basis for the transfer was the assessment of the Philippine General Hospital that Romualdez was “fit to be confined”
